arguments.content: Based on recent case law, specifically National Medical Devices Alliance v. FTC (7th Cir. 2024), federal antitrust claims under Sherman Act Section 1 regarding medical device pricing are likely preempted by the Medical Device Amendments to the FD&C Act (21 U.S.C. § 360k). This creates a significant jurisdictional barrier, as federal courts may lack subject matter jurisdiction where the FDA has regulatory authority over pricing. While the complaint alleges price-fixing with damages over $50M and meets diversity jurisdiction thresholds under 28 U.S.C. § 1332, the preemption issue undermines the substantive viability of the claim. A motion to dismiss under Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(b)(6) is likely to succeed. We recommend evaluating alternative legal theories or jurisdictions, or preparing for early summary judgment under Rule 56 given the absence of a viable claim.

arguments.content: This memorandum provides a status update on the medical malpractice matter (Case No. 2024-CV-06618, Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois). The complaint was filed on September 15, 2024, and the defendant filed an Answer and Motion to Dismiss on October 1 and October 20, 2024, respectively. Our opposition was filed on November 5, 2024. The case remains active. Key upcoming deadlines include: response to interrogatories (due January 10, 2025), deposition of key witness (January 25, 2025), and scheduled mediation (February 14, 2025). Discovery cutoff is January 15, 2025, and expert disclosures are due by March 1, 2025. All deadlines are being actively monitored. Regarding the statute of limitations, although the injury occurred on June 15, 2023, discovery of the injury was on December 15, 2024. Under the discovery rule in Illinois, the two-year statute of limitations for medical malpractice (735 ILCS 5/13-212(a)) runs from the date the injury was or reasonably should have been discovered. Therefore, the claim was timely filed. No conflicts of interest were identified. All actions to date are consistent with case strategy. Please reference DOC-EXT-3304 in all outbound correspondence.
